name: How often should I get a professional siding damage assessment?

mainEntity.name: How often should I get a professional siding damage assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is recommended to have a professional siding damage assessment at least once every two to three years, even if you don't notice obvious issues. After severe weather events, such as heavy storms or high winds, an immediate inspection is advisable. Regular assessments can help identify minor problems before they escalate into costly repairs, protecting your home's structural integrity and energy efficiency. Early detection saves time and money in the long run.
acceptedAnswer.description: Aim for a professional siding assessment every two to three years, or immediately after severe weather, to catch problems early.
